evals.prompt: Make an editable soft 3D fox companion using my approved character sheet, at the furry Grifon quality. Keep its face and show front and close-up renders.
evals.expected_output: Character track; preserve fox identity, adapt geometry rather than reskin griffin, regional groom and independent visual review; editable scene and render evidence without claiming live animation.

evals.prompt: Build a premium Blender perfume bottle render from these front and side photos. Use my exact label. The cap is brushed metal and the bottle is glass.
evals.expected_output: Product track; inspect dimensions or state approximation, exact artwork and UV placement, distinct glass/metal materials and macro reflection/seam review. No compulsory fur or nonmetallic preset.

evals.prompt: Turn my measured floor plan into a furnished 3D condo interior with three eye-level views. Missing finish choices can use sensible defaults.
evals.expected_output: Architecture track; measured scale/openings, compare plan blockout, clearly mark authored finish assumptions, plausible furniture scale and lighting; no claim of engineering documentation.

evals.prompt: Create a stylized market stall prop for our mobile game. I need the Blender master and a runtime export, not just a beauty render.
evals.expected_output: Game track; resolve engine/platform budget, master and runtime mesh, UV/normals/pivot and required LOD/collision checks, export/reimport and target testing or explicit pending status.
